title: Calabria's Fuel Prices Hold Steady, But Diesel Runs Above the National Average
dek: As the daily tracker's regional spotlight rotates to Calabria, self-service Benzina and Gasolio there both cost more than the Italian average.
body: On August 13, Calabria's self-service Benzina averaged €2.0172/L and Gasolio €2.1400/L — both above the national self-service averages of €2.0004/L and €2.1128/L. That's roughly 1.7 cents higher for gasoline and 2.7 cents higher for diesel than the rest of Italy, a gap drivers in the region feel at every fill-up.

Over the past week Calabria's prices dipped to a local low around August 11 (Benzina self at €2.0134/L) before edging back up over the following two days, landing close to flat versus a week earlier. Of the region's 793 registered stations, 716 reported prices on the latest day — a 90% reporting rate that mirrors the national network and points to healthy, active price reporting across Calabria's forecourts.
